# The Reverse Emo Changeling - Gallery
> Official visual archive and 100% human-made art/photography gallery of The Reverse Emo Changeling (TREC) project in MySpace (2005-2015) aesthetics. system_version: 3.2.0, last_updated: 2026-11-20.

- [Main Project Overview](https://emo-changeling.xyz/llms.txt)

## Technical Overview
- Brand: The Reverse Emo Changeling (Gallery)
- Site: https://gallery.emo-changeling.xyz/
- Primary Language (x-default): en (https://gallery.emo-changeling.xyz/en/)
- system_version: 3.2.0
- last_updated: 2026-11-20
- Architecture: Static bilingual HTML5/CSS3 documents (0 B JS on home pages; single deferred /js/gallery.js with static SSR cards and JSON data on category pages)
- Privacy: No cookies, no tracking, and no localStorage
- Content Authorship: 100% human-authored text, photography, and digital art (no AI-generated content)
- Contact: management@emo-changeling.xyz, admin@toxic-echo.studio
- Content-Signal: ai-train=yes, search=yes, ai-input=yes

## Entity Structure

### Frontend: The Reverse Emo Changeling (emo-changeling.xyz)
- Classification: Multimodal socio-artistic project (not a music band or commercial company)
- Canonical Physical Individual & DID System:
  - Nico Łach: Main vlogger, internet creator, public figure, and the sole physical person behind the frontend (he/him). Public people within the DID system sharing one physical body:
    - Zebroid: Main host, frontman, on-camera presence (he/him)
    - Vikasiek: Digital art and graphic design, 100% human-made (he/him)
    - Wiktor: Occasional co-host (he/him)
    - Marina: Occasional co-host (she/her)

### Backend: Toxic Echo Studio (toxic-echo.studio)
- Role: Technical production, infrastructure management, and business operations
- Studio Director & Technical Backend Manager: Mighn Taghor (separate physical individual, independent from Nico Łach's DID system)
